headlines.title: U.S. says China trade truce extended by 2 months
headlines.description: The agreement extends the suspension of some tariffs as Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Washington for a state visit.

headlines.title: Treasury yields surge to near 20-year high as oil jumps back above $103 per barrel
headlines.description: Mortgage rates hit the highest point of Trump’s second term, driven by the surging yield on 10-year Treasury bonds.

headlines.title: The U.S. economy before and after the Iran war, in five charts
headlines.description: Nearly seven months in, the conflict now casts a cloud of uncertainty — with no end in sight.

headlines.title: How to Navigate the Housing Market Amid Rising Interest Rates
headlines.description: The housing market is always changing, so real estate broker and president of R New York Stefani Berkin joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to separate fact from myth. See her expert breakdown, which includes the best time to buy a home, when to do repairs, and more.

headlines.title: Carla A. Harris Shares Career Advice, Talks AI and Jobs
headlines.description: Author and senior advisor at Morgan Stanley, Carla A. Harris joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share some advice to be successful in your career. She shares tips for getting noticed by your manager, and reacts to concerns about the job market with the increasing presence of AI. “I think this is one of the most exciting times for anybody in their career because all the rule books are being re-written…It’s not the time to be dictated to, it's the time to design,” she

headlines.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway
headlines.description: Warren Buffett announced he is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after 60 years at the firm. Investopedia editor-in-chief Caleb Silver breaks down how Buffett has impacted the investment world.

headlines.title: Why Networking is the Essential Career Tool
headlines.description: Networking can open doors and create opportunities, so LinkedIn editor-in-chief Dan Roth stops by TODAY with the keys to doing it effectively and making authentic connections. He shares tips on how to find your network, shares conversation starters when meeting someone new, explains how to make outreach personal and specific and more.

headlines.title: American dream of owning a home out of reach for many as mortgage rates soar (again)
headlines.description: Interest rates on a 30-year fixed mortgage soared to 7.2%. Coupled with near record high prices, it’s putting homeownership out of reach for millions.

headlines.title: Judge orders White House to restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico
headlines.description: A federal judge ordered early Thursday that the White House immediately restore access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico, saying that President Donald Trump’s directive barring the three news outlets was most likely unconstitutional.

headlines.title: Judge set to rule on Trump administration’s rationale for White House media ban
headlines.description: A Trump-appointed federal judge said he would rule “as soon as possible” after a hearing on whether to block a policy barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House grounds.

headlines.title: Defending Trump media ban, DOJ cites national security and says White House access is a ‘privilege’
headlines.description: The court filing urges a federal judge not to block the order ahead of a hearing after CNN, MS NOW and Politico sued.

headlines.title: Trump bought and sold shares in Musk’s SpaceX in July, financial disclosure shows
headlines.description: Donald Trump bought up to $50,000 worth and sold up to $15,000 of shares in Elon Musk’s SpaceX in July,his latest stock buy involving a government contractor.
